name: Boggart
gmNotes: A Boggart is a domestic researcher who observes humans and runs behavioural experiments that are perceived as pranks, mischief, or hauntings. Most work under contract with a nearby laboratory and wear brown environmental filters like Hobs and Brownies. Boggart is a fey-role Archetype, not a Species.
description: A mischievous household spirit blamed for hidden belongings, slammed doors, spoiled milk, frightened animals, and practical jokes that stop being funny.
